title: Customer Communication for Glaziers | Email, SMS & Chat | Coglass
description: Email, SMS and customer chat tracked against every glazing job, with automatic updates as the job moves. Facebook Messenger and WhatsApp coming soon.
lead: Email, SMS and the customer chat on your quote and tracking pages — tracked against the order, so nothing is lost in someone's personal phone. Automatic updates go out as the job moves. Facebook Messenger and WhatsApp are coming soon.
steps_h2: Every customer conversation, linked to the job
steps_sub: No more hunting through WhatsApp to find what was said about a job. Every message is stored in Coglass against the order it belongs to.
inc_h2: Every channel your customers use, in one place
inc_sub: Stop juggling WhatsApp on your personal phone, emails in Outlook and texts on another device. Coglass brings them all together.
steps: Connect your Gmail or Outlook mailbox in Settings — a one-time setup you do yourself. Texts go out through Coglass's own SMS service under your company name, with a monthly allowance on every plan. Facebook Messenger and WhatsApp are coming soon, once Meta has approved them.
Open any order and reply by email or SMS from the order screen. The customer's contact details are pre-filled — no copying numbers between apps.
Customer emails and messages sent from their quote or tracking page land in the Coglass inbox, and can be linked to the right order in one click.

Configure automation rules that trigger SMS or email messages automatically when job status changes — glass ready, fitter on the way, job complete. Your customers stay informed without anyone lifting a finger.
Automation rules come with ready-made messages for the common moments — booking confirmed, glass ready, on the way. Variables like {customerName} and {orderNumber} fill in from the job.
Emails and chat messages are kept with the order, so anyone picking up the job sees what was said.
included: WhatsApp — coming soon
Send and receive WhatsApp messages in Coglass. Built, and waiting on Meta's approval before we switch it on for customers.
SMS messaging
Text customers from any order. Sent under your company name through Coglass's SMS service, with a monthly allowance on every plan.
Gmail integration
Connect your Gmail account — send and receive emails from within Coglass, tracked against jobs.
Outlook integration
Connect Microsoft Outlook — full email integration with the same order-linked tracking.
Automated notifications
Trigger SMS and email automatically when order status changes — glass ready, fitter en route, job complete.
Custom automation rules
Build your own triggers and actions — any status change, any channel, any message template.
Ready-made messages
Automation rules come with starter messages using variables like customer name, order number and quote link.
Customer chat portal
Customers can reply to messages via a web link — no WhatsApp or app required on their side.
Full conversation history
Emails and chat messages are stored against the order — new staff can see the full picture straight away.
Link messages to jobs
Incoming emails show up with a one-click "link to this order" suggestion, so nothing needs hunting down.
Notification alerts
Team members are notified when a customer replies — no messages left unread because they came in on someone else's phone.
Facebook Messenger — coming soon
Answer your Facebook Page's Messenger enquiries from the Coglass inbox. Built, and waiting on Meta's approval.
cta_h2: Keep customers informed without the extra effort
cta_p: Book a demo and we'll walk you through it on the kind of jobs you do — or pick a plan and start a 14-day trial.
